model_annotation:
This line plot illustrates the percentage of employed individuals across different age groups, categorized by migration background. The x-axis represents age, with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70, marked at intervals of 10, and no units specified. The y-axis represents the percentage of employed individuals, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, marked at intervals of 20, and the unit is percent. 

The plot features four lines, each representing a distinct category: "ohne Migrationshintergrund" (black), "in Deutschland geboren" (gray), "zugewandert bis 2009" (light blue), and "zugewandert seit 2010" (blue). The black line starts at approximately 80% at age 20, peaks at around 95% between ages 30 and 50, and declines to 0% at age 70. The gray line starts at around 70% at age 20, peaks at approximately 85% between ages 30 and 50, and declines to 0% at age 70. The light blue line starts at around 60% at age 20, peaks at approximately 75% between ages 30 and 50, and declines to 0% at age 70. The blue line starts at around 40% at age 20, fluctuates between 40% and 60% up to age 50, sharply declines to 0% at age 65, and shows a small peak at age 68.
